title: ZeroDuino
summary: Portable Arduino IDE to edit, compile, and upload sketches directly from Cardput
description:
ZeroDuino is a lightweight, portable Arduino IDE designed specifically for the CardputerZero's 320x170 display and compact keyboard. Write, compile, and upload Arduino sketches on the go without needing a PC or manual terminal setup.

Key Features:
- Ready to use out of the box: Includes arduino-cli bundled inside the app and automatically downloads the required board core (such as arduino:avr) on first use over Wi-Fi.
- Sketch management: Create, edit, save, open, and delete .ino projects organized in ~/ZeroDuino/, including built-in starter templates like Blink.
- Board & port tools: Choose from common boards (Arduino Uno, Nano, Mega, ESP32 Dev) and detect connected USB serial ports automatically.
- Direct compile & upload: Verify your code and flash it directly to your Arduino board via USB.
- Keyboard-friendly menus: Navigate quickly using function shortcuts: fn+3 (Program: Compile/Upload), fn+4 (File), fn+5 (Edit), fn+7 (Tools), and fn+8 (Help).

Usage Notes:
- Make sure Wi-Fi is connected the first time you compile so ZeroDuino can automatically install the board core.
- To upload sketches to an Arduino board, set the side USB-SW switch to Host mode and connect your board to the USB-A or USB-C1 port.
